# Single Core Labs

> We build infrastructure, data, and intelligence for the next era of AI.

Single Core Labs is an AI infrastructure company based in Pune, India.
It builds AI infrastructure, data pipelines, and intelligence for production AI.

## About us

We design original architectures and ship them into production — across healthcare, infrastructure, and developer tooling.
Our mission is to build infrastructure, data, and intelligence for the next era of AI.
We partner with enterprises in high-stakes industries such as finance, tech, manufacturing, healthcare, and defense to co-create tailored AI systems.

## Focus

- AI infrastructure
- AI data pipelines
- Model training and tuning
- AI deployment
